text: When you have many nodes connected to each other, that's a mesh topology. So they take the name from the type of topology, this blue. But the peculiar aspect of these networks is indeed that only few nodes that are access point routers are directly connected within them. The others, as I said, are instead connected between each other and eventually with one of the red access point routers. What does that mean? How can the users that live in this building upload or download traffic to/from the internet? If you think about it, all these users will be able to do it, right? But how? Well, the users who live in this building will have to, for example, upload their traffic to this access point router, and then this traffic will have to be routed towards one of the red nodes, and then from here to the internet. If they want to download traffic from the internet, this traffic will go from the internet to the red node and then back to this blue node and then to the user. If.
